title: How we [work]
intro: Clear stages and regular demos: you see progress and shape the product at every step.

steps.title: Brief & discovery
steps.description: We dig into your business, users and constraints, then lock in goals, priorities and how we’ll know the product works.

steps.title: Prototype & design
steps.description: We build a clickable prototype, validate the flows and take the interface to final design with motion and a design system.

steps.title: Development in sprints
steps.description: We work in two-week sprints. Each one ends with a demo of a working build — results, not status reports.

steps.title: Testing & launch
steps.description: We test on real devices and real data, fix what we find, set up monitoring and ship the release.

steps.title: Support & growth
steps.description: After launch we stay close: fixing, updating and evolving the product based on data and user feedback.
